snippets.snippet_text: [Stated in layout: subhero heading] "Join the creative marketplace where millions of shoppers spend billions each year purchasing directly from creative entrepreneurs like you."

[Stated in layout: FAQ block — "How do fees work on Etsy?"] "There are three basic selling fees: a listing fee, a transaction fee, and a payment processing fee. There's also an advertising fee for sales that come from Offsite Ads. It costs $0.20 to publish a listing to the marketplace. A listing lasts for four months or until the item is sold. Once an item sells, there is a 6.5% transaction fee on the sale price (including the shipping price you set). If you accept payments through Etsy Payments, we also collect a 3% + $0.25 payment processing fee when an item is sold."
